title: What happens if you forget to sign your scorecard?
question: After finishing your round in a stroke play competition, you hand in your scorecard but forget to sign it. What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: Your scorecard is accepted because the marker signed it.
You are disqualified from the competition.
You may sign it later when you realise your mistake.

explanation: In a stroke play competition, both the player and the marker must sign the scorecard before it is returned. If the player fails to sign the scorecard before it is returned to the Committee, the player is disqualified, unless the Committee decides that an exceptional circumstance applies. Once the scorecard has been returned, you cannot simply add your signature later. Rule Reference: Rule 3.3b(4).
